description: Intelligent rack PDUs over Modbus TCP: PDU layout, peripheral sensors, inlet and pole readings, overcurrent protectors and outlet readings and switching
notes: Modbus TCP server, enabled in the web UI (Device Settings, Network Services). Functions 01, 05, 15 for coils and 03, 06, 16, 22 for holding registers; addresses are the hexadecimal entity addresses of the manual (wire addresses).
Multi-register values are big-endian (high word first): floats, 32-bit and 64-bit counters.

The register set repeats per component. This map lists inlet 1 with poles 1-3, overcurrent protectors 1-6, outlets 1-24 and peripheral sensors 1-8. Others follow the manual's formulas: inlet i (0-15) at 0x3000 + i × 0x100, OCP i (0-63) at 0x4000 + i × 0x100, outlet i (0-127) at 0x8000 + i × 0x100, peripheral sensor i (0-31) at 0x0800 + i × 0x10, with the same offsets; OCP trip coils at 0x0000 + i and outlet coils at 0x0100 + i.
The transfer switch block (0x2000, PX3TS only) is not in this map.
Written from the manufacturer's document; not tested on a device.
